title: PrestaShop Themes
meta: Start from a proven PrestaShop theme and we tailor it to your brand, with layout, colors and home sections. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: A proven PrestaShop theme, tailored to your brand
overview: Starting from a well built PrestaShop theme is the quickest way to a good looking store. We help you choose one that matches your products, install it, and tailor it to your brand with your logo, colors, fonts and layout. We arrange the home page, set up menus and footer, and check the whole thing on a phone. You get a short guide so you can keep editing without breaking the design.

pkgs.blurb: A suited theme installed and styled with your brand.
More tailoring across menus, blocks and product pages.
A fully tailored theme with child theme and editing guide.

faq: Do I have to buy a theme?
No. The default PrestaShop themes are free and solid. If you prefer a paid theme from an add on marketplace, you buy the licence and we set it up for you.
How is this different from a redesign?
This starts from a ready made theme and tailors it, so it is quicker and cheaper. A redesign is built around your products and rebuilds key pages.
Can I keep editing the theme?
Yes. We use the theme options and page blocks wherever possible, and we leave a guide, so you can change text, images and banners without touching code.
Yes. We test on phone and tablet sizes and fix spacing, menus and tap targets before handover.
